question: Apocalypse Now exposed 1,250,000 feet of film, at 90 feet a minute, for a 147-minute cut. Minutes shot per minute used?
answer: 13,900 / 147 = about 94.5 minutes shot per minute used.
move: Count what was thrown away to learn what the finished thing really cost.
trap: Guessing about 10 to 1, as if most footage made the cut.
hint: Turn the footage into minutes first, then set it against the running time.
steps: 1,250,000 / 90 = about 13,900 minutes of film, some 230 hours.
The released cut keeps 147 of those minutes.
13,900 / 147 = about 94.5 minutes shot per minute used.
source: Murch, In the Blink of an Eye
reference: Murch, In the Blink of an Eye: A Perspective on Film Editing, 2nd edn, Silman-James Press, 2001
